summary.text: Ryan Moffitt is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 63, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Ian Baltutis; no incumbent is running.
His campaign website describes him as an attorney who serves as chairman of the Alamance Chamber of Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Moffitt's campaign website says he completed his undergraduate degree at the College of Charleston and graduated from Elon University School of Law.
It says he is a member of the North Carolina Bar Association and the Alamance Community Foundation, and that he lives in Burlington with his wife, Ashley, and their two young sons.
